creative_direction: Show Masao Sato with his recognizable round child head, closely cropped hair, and a simple yellow-green casual shirt. He holds a small unlettered sketchbook against his chest, shoulders gently drawn inward. Let him smile shyly while looking directly toward the viewer. Use warm oatmeal paper and keep the book below his chin. Use matte gouache, short deliberate brush marks, and a softly mottled but uncluttered background. Use lavender irises with a few thin concentric rings around visible dark pupils. Confine the rings to the irises, preserving clear highlights and an approachable expression. Create an original, nonviolent fan-art avatar, square 1024x1024. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
